BWCA Basecamp Near Ely
Stay close to the Boundary Waters before or after your trip, or use us as your basecamp and explore at your own pace. Bunkrooms, campsites, hot showers all just four miles from Ely on Fernberg Road. It s a great spot for groups who want to paddle, unwind after a day on the water, or try out day trips before planning a longer Boundary Waters route.
Basecamp
Rates & Information
See the sections below for details about our bunkrooms, campsites, and overnight options. Rates depend on your outfitting package, group size, and lodging choice.
Private Bunkrooms
With Complete Outfitting $24
With Partial Outfitting $29
No Outfitting $34
2-person minimum required.
Campsites
With Complete Outfitting FREE
With Partial Outfitting $12
No Outfitting $16
BWCA Day Trips
Not everyone wants to commit to a multi-day canoe trip with portages and full camping gear. Many guests stay at Cliff Wold’s BWCA Basecamp and explore the Boundary Waters through day trips —paddle for the day, then return to your bunkroom or campsite each night.
Day-use BWCA permits are free and are available at all BWCA landings. We also have permits available at our outfitting shop in Ely.
Additional Amenities
Showers & Sauna
Hot showers included with all bunkroom and campsite stays
Post-trip showers included for outfitting package customers
Post-trip showers available for purchase for canoe-only and individual gear rentals
Men’s and women’s saunas available upon request
Check-In Information
All guests check in at our outfitting shop in Ely during normal business hours ( advance reservation preferred ). Payment and trip details are handled at check-in before heading to the campground.
Cliff Wold’s Outfitting Co.
1731 E Sheridan St
Ely, MN
Arriving after hours? Please let us know in advance and we’ll make arrangements to accommodate late arrivals.
Stay Awhile
Make Cliff Wold s Your BWCA Basecamp
You can enjoy the Boundary Waters without committing to a multi-day route. Spend your days paddling from a nearby entry point of your choice, then come back each evening to your comfortable bunkroom or campsite. This is a great choice for first-time paddlers, families, or groups who want to explore new entry points and have a welcoming place to return to at night.

About
About Cliff Wold's Outfitting Co
History
Cliff Wold s has been outfitting paddlers for the Boundary Waters since 1961. What started as a small shop in Ely grew from Cliff s deep knowledge of the wilderness and his desire to share it with anyone willing to paddle in.
More than 60 years later, that s still what brings people through our doors. We take the guesswork out of planning so you can spend more time on the water and less time worrying about the details.
For generations of paddlers, those trips have turned into stories around the campfire, traditions passed down through families, and memories that stick for a lifetime.
A great Boundary Waters trip starts well before you reach the water — that s still true today. We bring the gear, the planning, and the logistics together around the trip you want to take, so you arrive ready, confident, and excited to get out there.
Carrying the Tradition
Forward
Ryan Olson grew up in Ely, Minnesota, and got his start at Cliff Wold’s as a teenager. He worked for Cliff and Susan Wold throughout high school and into college, learning the outfitting business from the ground up and gaining firsthand experience helping people prepare for Boundary Waters trips of every kind.
After college, Ryan spent a few years working in the Twin Cities, but he realized he missed Ely, the outdoors, and the Boundary Waters. In 2009, he returned home and took over Cliff Wold’s Outfitting Co., continuing the tradition Cliff and Susan built over decades.
Today, Ryan and his wife Amy remain deeply involved in the day-to-day operations of the business. Together with their daughters, Ava and Hailey, they’re proud to call Ely home and are committed to carrying on the friendly service, honest advice, and straightforward outfitting experience customers have trusted for generations.
Whether someone is planning their very first canoe trip or returning for another Boundary Waters adventure, the goal remains the same: help every group feel prepared, supported, and excited to get on the water.

Whether you’re planning your first Boundary Waters trip or returning for another adventure, Cliff Wold’s makes getting ready simple. Tell us the kind of trip you have in mind, and we’ll help you put the pieces in place so you can arrive in Ely ready to go.

FAQs
FAQs Cliff Wold's Outfitting Co Frequently Asked
Questions
If this is your first trip to the Boundary Waters, planning can bring up a lot of questions. Here s what we hear most: outfitting, permits, meals, packing, timing. If your question isn t here, just call us.
What is the best time to visit the Boundary Waters?
Fishing permits don t open until mid-May. Bugs are worst from late June through late July and stick around into August. Mid-summer is the hottest stretch, and September brings cooler weather with far fewer crowds.
Which outfitting option should I choose?
The correct outfitting package for you comes down to what gear you already have and what you’re able to bring with you. Complete Outfitting is the simplest option if you want everything from trip planning, canoes, and gear to meals and transportation in one package. Partial Outfitting is a good fit if you have some gear or food of your own. À la carte rentals work best if you know exactly what you need and only want to rent certain items.
Do you help with permits and route planning?
Yes, we do. Your permit, entry point, route, group size, and travel dates all connect, so it s helpful to discuss these details early. We can help you sort out your route, permit timing, and outfitting needs before your trip. You ll still guide your own canoe trip, but you don t have to plan everything by yourself.
How do Cliff Wold's custom-packed meals work?
You pick your menu before your trip, and we measure, pack, and label your group s meals. Food packs are sorted by meal and day, with fresh foods for the start of your trip and freeze-dried options for later. You ll cook at camp, but we take care of the meal prep before you get here.
What should I bring for my canoe trip?
If you pick Complete Outfitting, we supply the main canoeing, camping, cooking, and meal gear. You ll still need to bring personal items like clothes, shoes, toiletries, medication, rain gear, and other basics. For Partial Outfitting or à la carte rentals, check your package or rental list closely so you know what else to bring or rent.
Can I stay at Cliff Wold's before or after my trip?
Yes, you can. Cliff Wold s BWCA Basecamp has bunkrooms and campsites near Ely for groups who want to stay before or after their canoe trip. You can also use it as a home base for BWCA day paddles if you want to explore the area without taking on a full multi-day route right away.

Each group has different questions. Some already know their route but need gear, while others have dates set and still need help with permits, meals, or transportation. Let us know what you have figured out, and we ll help you build a trip plan that fits your needs.

How to Plan Your Trip
How to Plan Your Trip Cliff Wold's Outfitting Co How To Plan
your Trip
Planning a Boundary Waters trip is easier than it looks once you take it in order. Start with your group, pick your dates, and we ll help with everything after that. Cliff Wold s can help you figure out permits, entry points, outfitting, meals, transportation, and the details that make your trip easier to manage before you reach the water.
Travel
Planning Process
We ll help you move from early ideas to a clear BWCA trip plan.
Start
with Your Group
How many people are going, and what s everyone s experience level? Your group size, comfort with portaging, wilderness experience, and trip goals all shape the route, pace, and outfitting support that will make sense.
Pick
Your Dates
Every season has something to offer up here. Spring brings fishing opener and fewer people on the lakes. Summer is our busiest time, with warm weather and families heading out on vacation. Fall means quieter lakes, fall colors and good fishing. Whenever you decide to come, we recommend booking early to get the dates you want.
Choose
Your Route
Your entry point and route should match your group s goals. Some paddlers want easier access and relaxed travel days. Others want deeper routes but those may come with longer days of paddling. Cliff Wold s can help you compare options and plan a route that fits your group.
Choose Your Entry Point
Reserve
Your Permit
Secure your BWCA permit with confidence. We can help you reserve the right permit for your route, entry point, and travel dates while making sure your group is ready for the adventure ahead.
Reserve Your Permit Today

Your Outfitting
Get the gear, canoes, meals, and support your group needs for the trip ahead. Whether you need a full outfitting package or just a few essentials, we’ll help you build the right setup for your route and experience level.
